title: Trump Self-Soothes With Golf and AI Slop After Public Meltdown
description: Jonathan Ernst / REUTERS President Donald Trump hit the links —again—on Saturday, following a widely panned White House Correspondents’ Dinner speech and a surreal, AI-generated “air filter” wall meant to stop Canadian wildfire smoke. The war in Iran also churned on as Trump relaxed at his Trump National Golf Club in Sterling, Virginia, just two days after the Pentagon inexplicably removed the names of four of 18 U.S. military personnel killed in Iran from a public casualty list. Read more at The Daily Beast.

title: Lee Tells Korean Americans: AI Era Brings New Opportunity for Korea
description: President Lee Jae-myung told Korean Americans in San Francisco that the AI era brings a new opportunity for Korea, vowing to make the country "irreplaceable" and a global leader.
